title: unified-rollouts: add adaptive canary / A-B / shadow rollout orchestration + automated rollback improvements
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: customers need a single, composable rollout primitive that supports progressive canaries, A/B splits, shadow probing, and automated multi-metric rollback policies. This PR implements the orchestration core and safety guards used by Redwood Console and Dedicated rollouts. Summary of changes: 1) rollout engine: new 'strategy' layer that composes canary, weighted A/B, and shadow probes with timeline and probe-window primitives; 2) adaptive traffic controller: feedback loop that adjusts canary weight based on composite metric scoring (latency P99, error rate, and model quality deltas from eval hooks); 3) automated rollback: multi-metric gating with hysteresis and cooldown, configurable thresholds, and fast abort path; 4) observability: new rollout-specific metrics (rollout.progress, rollout.score, rollout.abort_reason) and dashboard panels; 5) tests: unit coverage for controller logic, integration tests for staged shadow probing, and e2e canary stability test harness; 6) migration: rollout configs keep backward-compatible defaults; older policy YAMLs will be automatically converted on read. Backwards compatibility and safety: default rollout policy remains unchanged (simple canary without auto-rollback) unless an operator opts into 'adaptive' or 'auto-rollback' flags. The implementation favors explicit opt-in to aggressive rollback behavior. Rollout plan: staged rollout in prod control plane: enable feature-flag for 10% of orgs, expand after 1 week of monitoring. Related Linear tickets: ENG-3412, ENG-3490, ENG-3521.
